1. Displaying items spread out in an elegant, natural flat-lay arrangement

3. Creating visual separation between items
4. Maintaining the white background aesthetic

The FlatLayComposite component (apps/web/components/outfit/FlatLayComposite.tsx) currently uses absolute positioning with rotation transforms to place items, but the positioning values and layout logic don't create a true flat-lay aesthetic.
